tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Window and page background. Default ground for ink, ink-muted and brand text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: File list, editor and dialog panes sitting on surface. Ink, ink-muted and brand text read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, toolbar wells, hover row and screenshot backdrops. Ink and ink-muted read on it; do not set brand text on it in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and brand-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (owner, modified date, hints) on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and brand-subtle.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between panes and rows. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Copper. The one primary action in a view, the mark, the folder icon, links. Text color on surface, surface-raised and brand-subtle.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button, app icon glyph).

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row and selected sidebar item. Ink and ink-muted text on top.

tokens.name: patina
tokens.usage: Verdigris. Progress fills, focus ring, success. Secondary accent; never competes with brand in one control.

tokens.name: on-patina
tokens.usage: Text on a solid patina fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid ring, 2px offset, on every focusable element; 3:1 or better on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Synced, completed. Text on surface and surface-raised; always with the word or a check icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Syncing, informational. Text on surface and surface-raised; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Offline, quota nearly full. Text on surface and surface-raised; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed transfers, destructive actions. Text on surface and surface-raised; always with a word or icon.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Name and hero lines on the site and README art.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section heads on the site and docs.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles in docs; dialog titles use ui-title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running copy on the site and docs.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Dialog and pane titles in the app.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.usage: Hints, status bar, secondary row text.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Sizes, dates, paths, shortcuts, CLI and logs.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Dense columns and status bar numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dot trail size.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; lockup gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane padding, pattern pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups in a pane.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on the site.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: File list row height, compact density.

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: File list row height, default density.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, keyboard hints, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Progress bars and status pills: the rounded end echoes the D of the mark.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, dialogs. Panes use border, never shadow.
